_comment: Canadian Language Benchmark (CLB) descriptor reference for scoring writing and speaking responses. These are publicly documented benchmark bands (1-12). Calibrate/edit this file as needed rather than editing scoring logic.

writingDimensions.name: Content and Coherence
writingDimensions.description: Relevance and development of ideas, logical organization, and clarity of connections between ideas and paragraphs.

writingDimensions.name: Vocabulary
writingDimensions.description: Range, precision, and appropriateness of word choice for the task and audience.

writingDimensions.name: Readability
writingDimensions.description: Grammatical accuracy, sentence structure control, spelling, and punctuation that affect ease of reading.

writingDimensions.name: Task Fulfillment
writingDimensions.description: How completely and appropriately the response addresses all parts of the prompt, including tone and format requirements.

speakingDimensions.name: Content and Coherence
speakingDimensions.description: Relevance and development of ideas with logical, connected delivery.

speakingDimensions.name: Vocabulary
speakingDimensions.description: Range, precision, and appropriateness of word choice for the task.

speakingDimensions.name: Listenability
speakingDimensions.description: Pronunciation, intonation, pacing, and overall ease of understanding for a listener.

speakingDimensions.name: Task Fulfillment
speakingDimensions.description: How completely and appropriately the response addresses the task prompt.

listeningReadingScoreMap._comment: Example raw-score-to-CLB conversion table. Replace with calibrated values as needed. Format: [minCorrect, maxCorrect] -> CLB level, out of totalQuestions.
